The '''Farns''' was a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|gang]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Geordi Hans]], [[Jeff Pill]], [[Franklin Scott]], and [[AB-6]] were members of the gang. To call them a swoop gang was a bit of a misnomer, since during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] only [[Franklin Scott]] owned a vehicle, and it was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]], not a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]].<ref name="GG7" />
